title: 金属与芯片映射走强，油气锂链承压；英伟达财报前夜盘转弱 + 美股盘前：PCE符合预期、长债与科技转强，NVDA财报前保持条件式看多
summary: Moomoo完整扫描145个美股行业，铀、医药零售、铝、白银和铜领涨，专业零售、化学制品与鞋服链居末；黄金和其他贵金属均涨2.18%，半导体涨1.85%。Sparks完整加载118张概念卡并取得109个结构化概念，加密、稀土居前，锂电池、体育和锂矿居末。08:28 CST夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA代理分别跌0.270%、0.125%、0.011%，资源与成长信号分化。 7月总体与核心PCE均环比上涨0.2%，二季度GDP维持1.5%；盘前QQQ、SPY与TLT代理走强，AMD、COIN、SNPS和NVDA领涨。核心PCE同比仍为3.3%，今晚NVDA及软件安全财报使开盘量价与指引成为关键。

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗与阿曼商议霍尔木兹海峡临时航运走廊
美联社8月25日报道，两国外长讨论分阶段恢复船舶通行、建立临时航运走廊并协作清雷；但一艘油轮在阿曼外海遇袭，说明能源安全风险仍未解除。事实是外交窗口重开，判断上有利于压低油价风险溢价，失效条件是航运再受袭或谈判破裂。
国际
美国扩大对伊朗制裁，德黑兰警告将反制
美国进一步收紧对伊朗经济与能源网络的制裁，伊朗称不会屈服并警告支持制裁者。冲突与谈判并行使油价、航运和通胀预期保持高波动；亚洲市场需同时观察布油和长端美债。
科技
完整行业榜显示铀与金属链领涨，专业零售和化学制品居末
Moomoo完整读取5页145个行业：铀+4.82%、医药零售+3.17%、铝+2.70%、白银+2.69%、铜+2.64%居前；糖果-2.21%、服装制造-2.38%、鞋类及配饰-2.72%、化学制品-3.00%、专业零售-4.25%居末。黄金与其他贵金属均+2.18%，对A/H金铜稀土形成正映射。
科技
Sparks加密与稀土概念走强，锂电池与锂矿承压
Sparks一次完整加载118张概念卡并取得109个完整结构化概念：加密矿企+6.26%、加密货币+5.51%、稀土+4.69%居前，GLXY +8.54%、EXOD +23.44%、CRML +21.44%；锂电池-2.54%、体育-2.86%、锂矿-3.99%居末。A/H开盘重点验证稀土资源能否放量、锂链是否继续弱于新能源大盘。
科技
半导体与存储现金时段走强，但夜盘科技代理回落
行业榜半导体+1.85%，MRAM +9.23%；Sparks存储概念+2.41%，WDC现金时段+3.53%。但08:28 CST夜盘QQQ -0.270%、WDC -0.829%，构成强势收盘后的背离；A/H芯片和存储只在集合竞价强于指数且成交放大时视为确认。
科技
英伟达今晚发布财报，AI链面临高波动验证
英伟达官方确认将于8月26日美股收盘后约16:20 ET公布FY2027二季度结果，17:00 ET举行电话会。NVDA现金时段+2.19%、夜盘+0.122%；A/H光模块、服务器和先进封装在财报前更适合等待量价确认，指引不及高预期将放大回撤。
财报
药明生物收入与EBIT高于预期，开盘反馈待验证
Futu财报日历显示上半年收入117.87亿元，高于预期114.73亿元约2.7%；EBIT 38.35亿元，高于预期32.31亿元约18.7%。结果于港股收市后披露，盘前尚无可验证股价反应；若竞价高开并守住量价，生物医药与CXO映射才成立。
财报
农夫山泉收入略超预期，利润保持双位数增长
Futu显示上半年收入297.18亿元，高于预期294.56亿元约0.9%；公开业绩资料显示归母利润88.87亿元、同比增长16.6%。结果在收市后披露，港股价格反馈待开盘；消费防御逻辑需以高开后承接验证。
财报
长城汽车收入超预期但EBIT略低，盈利质量仍需观察
Futu显示二季度收入569.92亿元，高于预期550.88亿元约3.5%；EBIT 20.16亿元，略低于预期20.32亿元约0.8%。港股尚未开市，不能把营收超预期直接等同于股价利好；毛利率、产品结构与竞价表现是首要验证项。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三只指数ETF代理小幅转弱
Futu OpenD于08:28 CST显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）-0.270%、SPY（标普500代理）-0.125%、DIA（道指代理）-0.011%。均为有成交的实时夜盘ETF代理而非指数期货；行情时间为08/25美东夜盘，抓取与更新时间同在30分钟内。
板块对照
行业与概念代表股同时出现确认、背离和潜在反转
行业Top5代表：EU无成交、HITI无成交、AA -0.585%背离、HSLV无成交、IE +1.595%确认；行业Bottom5：SOWG无成交、XELB无成交、FWDI 0.000%背离、GURE无成交、ABLV无成交。概念Top5：GLXY -0.322%背离、EXOD 0.000%背离、CRML +1.604%确认，GAME两项均无成交；概念Bottom5：EQT +0.314%、SLI +0.778%对页岩油及锂链弱势构成潜在反转，RGR与GIL无成交。结论以有成交项为准，不默认现金方向延续。
A/H映射
资源映射强于指数，芯片和锂链等待竞价确认
金银铜行业现金时段广度强，IE夜盘继续上涨，利多A/H金铜资源；但GLD夜盘-0.425%、QQQ转负，贵金属和高估值科技不宜追高。锂链虽有SLI夜盘+0.778%的反向信号，但只有锂矿、锂电集合竞价同时强于指数才算反转；若资源股高开低走或QQQ跌幅扩大，映射失效。

盘前结论

事实：隔夜美股现金时段风险偏好回升，标普500、道指和纳指分别上涨约0.32%、0.30%和0.66%，金银铜、半导体、存储与稀土主题走强。运行时夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA全部转负，且GLD、WDC回落，说明强势方向出现获利了结。

判断：A/H开盘优先观察金铜稀土与药明生物的独立催化，芯片链只做竞价强于指数后的条件式跟随。锂链虽有代表股夜盘反弹，但现金概念榜仍居末，短线采用“弱势未解除、等待反转确认”的信号。

不确定性：英伟达财报、伊朗制裁与霍尔木兹航运谈判可能在同一天改变科技估值和能源风险溢价；若北向/南向成交不足或恒生科技低开扩大，减少追涨。

重点个股推荐

紫金矿业
02899.HK / 601899.SH
金铜共振

推荐理由：黄金、白银和铜行业同步走强，公司具备金铜双重映射。

触发因素：竞价高于昨收且金铜板块成交额同步放大。

风险点：GLD夜盘下跌0.425%，若高开低走则现金时段利多已被透支。

华虹半导体
01347.HK
芯片映射

推荐理由：美股半导体行业上涨1.85%，存储与CPU主题亦居前。

触发因素：竞价强于恒生科技且中芯国际同步走强。

风险点：QQQ和WDC夜盘转负，英伟达财报前估值波动可能放大。

药明生物
02269.HK
业绩超预期

推荐理由：收入高于预期约2.7%，EBIT高于预期约18.7%。

触发因素：高开后守住首半小时均价，CXO同业同步跟涨。

风险点：盘前尚无价格反馈，若高开低走则业绩利好已被计价。

北方稀土
600111.SH
稀土映射

推荐理由：Sparks稀土概念上涨4.69%，CRML现金时段涨21.44%、夜盘再涨1.604%。

触发因素：稀土永磁板块竞价涨幅居前且量比放大。

风险点：海外代表股波动剧烈，若板块冲高回落应避免追价。

板块轮动看板

受益方向金、银、铜、稀土、CXO；现金时段行业广度与本地业绩共同支持。
观察方向半导体、存储、AI服务器；夜盘背离且英伟达财报临近。
压力方向锂电池、锂矿、油气与部分可选消费；概念榜与油价代理均偏弱。
验证信号竞价相对指数强弱、首30分钟成交、QQQ与GLD夜盘方向、资源高开承接。

逻辑链

美股金银铜、稀土与半导体现金时段走强，为A/H资源和科技提供正映射。
运行时QQQ、GLD与WDC转弱，说明科技和贵金属都存在获利回吐。
A/H开盘先看紫金、北方稀土、华虹与药明生物能否以成交确认独立催化。
若强势板块高开低走或恒生科技跌幅扩大，则转向防御消费并等待英伟达财报。

风险雷达

英伟达财报风险

高预期下收入或指引稍弱都可能冲击AI算力链。

中东再升级

制裁、反制或海峡遇袭会迅速抬升油价与通胀预期。

贵金属夜盘背离

行业现金时段强，但GLD夜盘转跌，追高需谨慎。

锂链弱势未解除

代表股夜盘反弹不等于板块趋势反转。

财报价格反馈缺失

A/H尚未开市，药明、农夫与长城汽车需用竞价验证。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（08:18—08:23 CST，页面时间08/25 20:20 ET；完整5页145行业，黄金/贵金属/白银/铜/半导体重点检查）；Moomoo/Futunn Sparks备用页与Futu同口径结构化数据（08:24—08:25 CST，一次加载118卡、109个完整概念，未重复抓取概念页）；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历与NOTICE搜索（08:17 CST）；Futu OpenD QQQ/SPY/DIA、行业与概念代表股夜盘字段（08:27—08:28 CST，ETF代理非指数期货，无成交逐项标注）；AP、HKEX、NVIDIA IR。抓取与更新时间均为Asia/Shanghai。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Global
Iran and Oman discuss a temporary Strait of Hormuz shipping corridor
AP reported on Aug. 25 that the two foreign ministers discussed phased vessel passage, a temporary corridor and joint mine-clearing. A tanker attack off Oman shows energy-security risk remains. The diplomatic window can reduce the oil premium; another attack or failed talks would invalidate that view.
Global
The US widens Iran sanctions as Tehran warns of retaliation
Washington tightened pressure on Iran's economy and energy network, while Tehran said it would not yield and warned sanctions supporters. Conflict and diplomacy are moving together, keeping oil, shipping and inflation expectations volatile; Asian investors should watch both Brent and long Treasury yields.
Tech
Full industry ranking puts uranium and metals on top, specialty retail and chemicals at the bottom
Across all 145 industries on five Moomoo pages, Uranium +4.82%, Pharmaceutical Retailers +3.17%, Aluminum +2.70%, Silver +2.69% and Copper +2.64% led. Confectioners -2.21%, Apparel Manufacturing -2.38%, Footwear -2.72%, Chemicals -3.00% and Specialty Retail -4.25% lagged. Gold and Other Precious Metals both rose 2.18%, positively mapping to A/H gold, copper and rare-earth names.
Tech
Sparks crypto and rare-earth themes rally while lithium batteries and mining lag
Sparks loaded all 118 cards once and returned 109 complete structured concepts. Crypto Mining +6.26%, Crypto Stocks +5.51% and Rare Earths +4.69% led, with GLXY +8.54%, EXOD +23.44% and CRML +21.44%. Lithium Batteries -2.54%, Sports -2.86% and Lithium Mining -3.99% lagged. The A/H test is volume in rare earths versus continued lithium underperformance.
Tech
Semiconductors and storage strengthened in cash trading, but tech proxies softened overnight
Semiconductors rose 1.85% with MRAM +9.23%; the Sparks storage concept gained 2.41% and WDC rose 3.53% in cash trading. At 08:28 CST, however, QQQ was -0.270% and WDC -0.829% overnight, a divergence after a strong close. A/H chips and storage require stronger-than-index auction prices and higher volume for confirmation.
Tech
Nvidia reports tonight, setting up a high-volatility test for the AI chain
Nvidia officially scheduled FY2027 Q2 results for about 16:20 ET on Aug. 26, followed by a 17:00 ET call. NVDA rose 2.19% in cash trading and 0.122% overnight. A/H optical, server and advanced-packaging names should wait for price-volume confirmation; guidance below elevated expectations could amplify losses.
Earnings
WuXi Biologics revenue and EBIT beat expectations; opening feedback remains unverified
Futu's calendar shows first-half revenue of RMB11.787bn, about 2.7% above the RMB11.473bn estimate, and EBIT of RMB3.835bn, about 18.7% above RMB3.231bn. The release came after Hong Kong's close, so no valid price reaction exists yet. A durable gap and volume are needed to confirm the CXO read-through.
Earnings
Nongfu Spring slightly beats revenue expectations as profit keeps double-digit growth
Futu shows first-half revenue of RMB29.718bn, about 0.9% above the RMB29.456bn estimate. Public results report attributable profit of RMB8.887bn, up 16.6% year over year. The release followed the close, so opening price feedback is pending; defensive-consumption strength requires post-gap support.
Earnings
Great Wall Motor beats revenue but slightly misses EBIT, leaving earnings quality under review
Futu shows Q2 revenue of RMB56.992bn, about 3.5% above RMB55.088bn, while EBIT of RMB2.016bn was roughly 0.8% below RMB2.032bn. Hong Kong has not opened, so a revenue beat cannot be treated as a stock-positive outcome; margins, mix and the auction are the key tests.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indices
All three index ETF proxies softened modestly
Futu OpenD at 08:28 CST showed QQQ (Nasdaq-100 proxy) -0.270%, SPY (S&P 500 proxy) -0.125% and DIA (Dow proxy) -0.011%. All were real-time overnight ETF proxies with trades, not index futures. Market time was the Aug. 25 US overnight session, and capture was within 30 minutes of the update.
Sector Check
Industry and concept leaders show confirmation, divergence and potential reversal
Industry Top5 representatives: EU unavailable, HITI unavailable, AA -0.585% divergence, HSLV unavailable and IE +1.595% confirmation. Industry Bottom5: SOWG unavailable, XELB unavailable, FWDI 0.000% divergence, GURE unavailable and ABLV unavailable. Concept Top5: GLXY -0.322% divergence, EXOD 0.000% divergence, CRML +1.604% confirmation, while both GAME rows were unavailable. Concept Bottom5: EQT +0.314% and SLI +0.778% signal potential reversal for weak shale and lithium; RGR and GIL were unavailable. Conclusions use traded names only and never assume cash direction persisted.
A/H Mapping
Resource mapping is firmer than the index signal; chips and lithium await auction confirmation
Gold, silver and copper had strong cash breadth and IE extended gains overnight, supporting A/H resource names. But GLD -0.425% and a negative QQQ argue against chasing precious metals or high-duration tech. SLI's +0.778% is only a counter-signal: lithium mining and batteries must both beat the index in the auction to confirm reversal. A resource gap-fade or deeper QQQ loss invalidates the mapping.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Fact: US cash risk appetite improved, with the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq up about 0.32%, 0.30% and 0.66%; gold, silver, copper, semiconductors, storage and rare earths strengthened.At runtime, QQQ, SPY and DIA all turned negative overnight, while GLD and WDC fell, showing profit-taking in prior leaders.

View: prioritize independent catalysts in A/H gold, copper, rare earths and WuXi Biologics; follow chips only if the auction beats the index.Although a lithium representative rebounded overnight, the cash concept ranking stayed near the bottom, so treat weakness as unresolved pending reversal confirmation.

Uncertainty: Nvidia earnings, Iran sanctions and Hormuz talks can jointly reset tech valuations and the energy premium. Reduce chasing if northbound/southbound turnover is weak or Hang Seng Tech opens progressively lower.

The A/H open must confirm independent catalysts in Zijin, Northern Rare Earth, Hua Hong and WuXi Biologics through turnover.
If leaders gap-fade or Hang Seng Tech losses widen, rotate defensive and await Nvidia's results.

Risk Radar

Nvidia Earnings Risk

With elevated expectations, even a modest revenue or guidance miss could hit the AI chain.

Middle East Re-Escalation

Sanctions, retaliation or another strait attack could quickly lift oil and inflation expectations.

Precious-Metals Divergence

Cash industries were strong, but GLD turned lower overnight; chasing is risky.

Lithium Weakness Unresolved

One representative's overnight bounce does not establish a sector reversal.

Earnings Price Feedback Missing

entries.summary: 7月总体与核心PCE均环比上涨0.2%，二季度GDP维持1.5%；盘前QQQ、SPY与TLT代理走强，AMD、COIN、SNPS和NVDA领涨。核心PCE同比仍为3.3%，今晚NVDA及软件安全财报使开盘量价与指引成为关键。
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
PCE环比符合预期，年通胀仍明显高于目标
BEA刚公布7月总体与核心PCE均环比上涨0.2%；总PCE同比3.7%，核心PCE同比3.3%。通胀没有意外加速，但仍高于美联储2%目标，利率敏感成长股只能获得有限缓冲。
增长
二季度GDP二次估值维持1.5%
BEA维持二季度实际GDP年化1.5%，低于一季度2.1%；私人国内最终销售上修0.3个百分点至4.2%。表面增长偏慢，但内需韧性降低了立即宽松的必要性。
期指
数据公布前期指窄幅震荡，盘前ETF转强
05:27 ET纳指100与标普500期指约跌0.20%和0.07%，道指期指约涨0.07%；08:19 ET盘前QQQ与SPY代理分别约涨0.62%和0.31%，显示数据发布前后风险偏好改善，但正式开盘仍需成交确认。
AI
NVIDIA财报成为全市场波动核心
NVDA今晚盘后公布FY2027二季度业绩；一致预期约为EPS 2.09美元、营收922亿美元。盘前股价约涨2.19%，但高预期下市场更关注下一季收入、Blackwell供给、毛利率和超大规模客户资本开支。
芯片
AMD与SNPS盘前显著跑赢指数
08:19 ET快照显示AMD约涨4.90%、SNPS约涨3.64%，明显强于QQQ。AMD受AI链风险偏好回升带动；SNPS还叠加今晚财报，但盘前成交量接口受限，不能把涨幅单独视为趋势确认。
加密
COIN与MSTR盘前同步走强
COIN约涨4.30%、MSTR约涨3.44%，加密相关风险偏好优于大盘。该方向对加密资产价格与流动性高度敏感，若开盘后相对QQQ强度消失，应迅速降级。
能源
油价继续回落，霍尔木兹谈判压低风险溢价
布油约跌1.12%至86.65美元，WTI约跌1.47%至80.46美元。伊朗与阿曼就维持霍尔木兹海峡通行推进谈判，短线有利于缓和通胀压力，但航运安全与制裁升级仍可快速逆转油价。
利率
长债与黄金代理盘前走高
10年期美债收益率早段约4.64%；08:19 ET盘前TLT约涨1.09%、GLD约涨0.32%。债券正反馈支持成长估值，但PCE同比仍高，若收益率在开盘后反弹，科技高开承接将受考验。
软件
今晚软件与安全财报密集
Salesforce、CrowdStrike、Okta、Synopsys、Nutanix与Veeva均在盘后日历。CRM盘前约跌1.61%、CRWD约跌2.81%，而SNPS约涨3.64%，价格反馈已显示市场对不同子行业预期明显分化。
海外
全球股市多上涨，油价回落支撑进口国
日本、韩国、香港与内地主要指数多数收涨，欧洲主要指数早盘偏强。全球AI买盘与能源成本回落提供支撑，但中东谈判若反复，跨资产波动仍可能在美股盘中重新放大。

盘前结论

事实：7月总体与核心PCE均环比上涨0.2%，二季度GDP维持1.5%；盘前QQQ、SPY与TLT代理均上涨，AMD、COIN、SNPS和NVDA显著强于大盘。这支持科技偏强开盘，但不是无条件追涨信号。

判断：基准情景是AI芯片与高贝塔方向领涨、软件内部继续分化。核心PCE同比仍达3.3%，CRM与CRWD出现负价格反馈，说明利率和财报门槛没有消失。

不确定性：开盘量能、10年期收益率和今晚NVDA指引将决定强势能否延续；若QQQ回吐盘前涨幅或AMD、COIN高开低走，应降低风险而不是把新闻叙事当买点。

关键资产图

QQQ盘前代理
约+0.62%
SPY盘前代理
约+0.31%
TLT盘前代理
约+1.09%

约-1.12%

关键词云图

NVDA财报PCE 0.2%AMD领涨长债走强通胀黏性加密反弹增长分化SNPS强势软件分化油价回落海峡谈判量价确认
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

Advanced Micro Devices
AMD
相对强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨4.90%，显著强于QQQ与多数大型芯片股，AI风险偏好回升得到价格正反馈；公开量能接口受限。

触发因素：开盘后保持强于QQQ与半导体同业，并出现成交扩张。

风险点：NVDA财报前可能只是仓位回补；若快速跌破盘前区间，停止追多。

Coinbase Global
COIN
动量观察

推荐理由：盘前约涨4.30%，与MSTR同步走强，显示加密链具备板块共振；公开量能接口受限。

触发因素：开盘继续强于QQQ，且加密资产与MSTR不出现反向背离。

风险点：高波动与监管/流动性敏感；若高开低走应降级为风险观察。

Synopsys
SNPS
事件强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨3.64%，明显跑赢大盘，且EDA长期受益于芯片复杂度提升；今晚财报前仅适合条件式仓位。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前涨幅、强于软件与芯片指数，并有成交放大。

风险点：盘后财报带来跳空，ANSYS整合、利润率或指引不及预期会放大回撤。

Micron Technology
MU
存储承接

推荐理由：盘前约涨2.43%，与AMD、NVDA共同获得AI链正反馈，且没有今晚本公司财报的单点风险；公开量能接口受限。

触发因素：开盘继续强于QQQ且存储同业同步上行。

风险点：若NVDA盘前强势回吐或存储价格预期转弱，板块可能快速反转。

板块轮动看板

强势观察半导体与加密：AMD、MU、NVDA、COIN；只跟随开盘后保持相对QQQ强势且成交扩张的标的。
事件驱动NVDA、SNPS、CRM、CRWD、OKTA盘后财报；实际PCE与GDP数据决定利率定价。
压力方向盘前负反馈的软件：CRM、CRWD；以及在核心PCE仍为3.3%背景下的高估值长久期资产。
验证信号QQQ/SPY能否守住盘前涨幅、TLT是否继续走强、AMD与COIN是否放量、10年期收益率是否反弹。

逻辑链

PCE环比未超预期、油价继续回落，先降低了通胀意外和能源冲击的短线风险溢价。
TLT、QQQ与SPY盘前代理转强，资金把有限的利率缓冲优先映射到AI、芯片和高贝塔加密链。
但核心PCE同比仍为3.3%，且私人内需上修，市场没有充分理由押注迅速降息。
因此基准情景是科技偏强但高度分化；开盘量价与今晚NVDA指引决定反弹能否延续。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，并非确定事实。已核对Earnings Whispers、Kiplinger、TipRanks、S&P Global、公司IR与公开预期；具体时间均为8月26日美股盘后。

高概率 · NVIDIA (NVDA) · 70%一致预期约EPS 2.09美元、营收922亿美元；过去四季连续超预期，超大规模资本开支仍强且60天EPS预期上修约0.02美元。风险是上修速度放缓、市场耳语高于一致预期，真正门槛在下一季指引与毛利率。
高概率 · Synopsys (SNPS) · 66%一致预期EPS 3.67美元、营收24.4亿美元；最近两季EPS分别超预期约6.35%和5.9%，上一季收入高于指引。风险是ANSYS整合、利息与利润率，使小幅beat未必换来正股价反应。
中概率 · Salesforce (CRM) · 60%一致预期EPS 3.27美元、营收113.3亿美元，近期卖方修正偏正且公司指引上沿接近一致预期。盘前约跌1.61%显示门槛不低；Agentforce变现、剩余履约义务与全年指引比单一EPS更重要。
中概率 · Okta (OKTA) · 58%一致预期EPS约0.97美元，公司此前给出的0.95—0.97美元指引高于早期一致预期；身份安全需求与经营杠杆提供支撑。风险是大型企业签单时点和谨慎指引，盘前仅约跌0.26%属中性反馈。
低概率 · CrowdStrike (CRWD) · 48%一致预期EPS约0.29美元、营收14.4亿美元；安全需求长期强，但市场更看ARR与净新增业务，盘前约跌2.81%明显弱于QQQ。负价格反馈与高门槛使其列低档，等待财报后确认而非提前押注。

风险雷达

NVDA高预期风险

即使收入与EPS超预期，下一季指引、毛利率或供给评论稍弱也可能冲击整个AI链。

核心通胀仍黏

核心PCE同比3.3%，长端收益率若在开盘后反弹，会压缩高估值科技的承接空间。

中东与航运反复

霍尔木兹谈判提供缓和，但新的袭击、制裁或通航受阻可令油价和通胀预期急升。

软件负价格反馈

CRM与CRWD盘前弱于QQQ，利好叙事不能覆盖市场惩罚；财报前不作为多头推荐。

盘前量能缺口

行情源提供涨跌但成交量接口被限流，所有推荐必须等待开盘成交扩张确认。

数据来源与时间点

来源：美国BEA 8:30 ET官方PCE与GDP发布稿；AP与TipRanks（期指、全球市场、油价、收益率、中东局势）；市场行情快照（QQQ、SPY、TLT、GLD、NVDA、AMD、MU、SNPS、COIN、CRM、CRWD、OKTA，08:19 ET附近）；Earnings Whispers、Kiplinger、S&P Global、TipRanks、Synopsys IR及公开业绩记录。抓取/更新时间：2026-08-26 20:38 CST。盘前成交量接口受限，推荐均要求开盘量价确认。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Macro
PCE matches monthly forecasts while annual inflation stays elevated
The BEA just reported that both headline and core PCE rose 0.2% month over month in July; headline PCE was 3.7% year over year and core PCE 3.3%. Inflation did not reaccelerate unexpectedly, but it remains above the Fed’s 2% target, offering only limited relief to rate-sensitive growth stocks.
Growth
Second-quarter GDP estimate remains at 1.5%
The BEA kept annualized second-quarter real GDP growth at 1.5%, down from 2.1% in the first quarter; real final sales to private domestic purchasers were revised up 0.3 point to 4.2%. Headline growth is soft, but resilient domestic demand reduces the urgency for immediate easing.
Futures
Futures were range-bound before the data as premarket ETFs firmed
At 5:27 ET, Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 futures were about 0.20% and 0.07% lower, while Dow futures were about 0.07% higher; by 8:19 ET, premarket QQQ and SPY proxies were up about 0.62% and 0.31%. Risk appetite improved around the release, but the cash open still needs volume confirmation.
AI
NVIDIA earnings are the market’s central volatility event
NVDA reports fiscal Q2 2027 results after the close; consensus is roughly $2.09 in EPS and $92.2 billion in revenue. Shares were up about 2.19% premarket, but with expectations elevated, next-quarter revenue, Blackwell supply, gross margin and hyperscaler capex matter more than a narrow headline beat.
Chips
AMD and SNPS materially outperform the index premarket
The 8:19 ET snapshot showed AMD up about 4.90% and SNPS up about 3.64%, well ahead of QQQ. AMD is benefiting from stronger AI risk appetite, while SNPS also has earnings tonight; premarket volume data were rate-limited, so price gains alone do not confirm a trend.
Crypto
COIN and MSTR advance together premarket
COIN rose about 4.30% and MSTR about 3.44%, showing crypto-linked risk appetite ahead of the broad market. The group is highly sensitive to crypto prices and liquidity; if relative strength versus QQQ disappears after the open, downgrade it quickly.
Energy
Oil extends its decline as Hormuz talks reduce the risk premium
Brent fell about 1.12% to $86.65 and WTI about 1.47% to $80.46. Iran and Oman are advancing talks aimed at keeping the Strait of Hormuz open, easing near-term inflation pressure, but shipping incidents or tougher sanctions could reverse oil quickly.
Rates
Long-duration bonds and gold trade higher premarket
The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.64% earlier; at 8:19 ET, premarket TLT was up about 1.09% and GLD about 0.32%. Positive bond feedback supports growth valuations, but annual PCE remains high, so a post-open yield rebound would test tech’s gap higher.
Software
Software and cybersecurity earnings cluster after the close
Salesforce, CrowdStrike, Okta, Synopsys, Nutanix and Veeva are all on the after-hours calendar. CRM was down about 1.61% and CRWD about 2.81% premarket, while SNPS gained about 3.64%, showing sharply differentiated expectations across software groups.
Global
Global equities mostly rise as lower oil helps importers
Major indexes in Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong and mainland China mostly closed higher, while key European markets leaned positive early. AI demand and lower energy costs support sentiment, but renewed Middle East friction could widen cross-asset volatility during the U.S. session.

Premarket Conclusion

Facts: headline and core PCE both rose 0.2% month over month, second-quarter GDP stayed at 1.5%, and premarket QQQ, SPY and TLT proxies were all higher, with AMD, COIN, SNPS and NVDA materially ahead of the market.That supports a tech-led open, but not unconditional chasing.

View: the base case is leadership from AI semiconductors and other high-beta groups, with continued dispersion inside software.Core PCE is still 3.3% year over year, while CRM and CRWD show negative price feedback, so rate and earnings hurdles remain.

Uncertainty: cash-open volume, the 10-year yield and NVDA guidance tonight determine persistence; if QQQ gives back its premarket gain or AMD and COIN gap and fade, reduce risk rather than treat headlines as an entry signal.

about +1.09%

about -1.12%

Keyword Cloud

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.

Key Stock Picks

Advanced Micro Devices
AMD
Relative strength

Why: AMD was up about 4.90% premarket, well ahead of QQQ and most large chip names, confirming better AI risk appetite in price; public volume access was limited.

Trigger: maintain leadership over QQQ and semiconductor peers after the open with expanding volume.

Risk: this may be positioning ahead of NVDA earnings; stop chasing if it quickly loses the premarket range.

Coinbase Global
COIN
Momentum watch

Why: COIN gained about 4.30% with MSTR also higher, showing group-level confirmation across crypto-linked equities; public volume access was limited.

Trigger: remain stronger than QQQ after the open while crypto assets and MSTR avoid a bearish divergence.

Risk: high volatility and regulatory/liquidity sensitivity; downgrade to risk watch on a gap-and-fade.

Synopsys
SNPS
Event strength

Why: SNPS rose about 3.64% premarket, materially beating the market, while EDA retains a long-run chip-complexity tailwind; use only conditional sizing before tonight’s report.

Trigger: hold the premarket gain, outperform software and chip indexes, and show expanding cash-session volume.

Risk: earnings create gap risk; ANSYS integration, margins or guidance below expectations could amplify a drawdown.

Micron Technology
MU
Memory support

Why: MU was up about 2.43% premarket with AMD and NVDA, confirming support across the AI chain without a company-specific earnings event tonight; public volume access was limited.

Trigger: remain stronger than QQQ after the open while memory peers advance together.

Risk: the group can reverse quickly if NVDA loses its premarket strength or memory pricing expectations weaken.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watchSemiconductors and crypto: AMD, MU, NVDA and COIN; follow only names that stay stronger than QQQ after the open with expanding volume.
Event-drivenAfter-hours results from NVDA, SNPS, CRM, CRWD and OKTA; actual PCE and GDP data reset rate pricing.
Pressure areasSoftware with negative premarket feedback, especially CRM and CRWD, plus high-duration assets while core PCE remains at 3.3%.
Validation signalsWhether QQQ/SPY hold premarket gains, TLT remains firm, AMD and COIN add volume, and the 10-year yield avoids a rebound.

Logic Chain

PCE did not beat monthly forecasts and oil kept falling, initially reducing the near-term risk premium for an inflation or energy shock.
Premarket TLT, QQQ and SPY proxies turned higher, directing limited rate relief toward AI, semiconductors and high-beta crypto-linked names.
Yet core PCE remains 3.3% year over year and private domestic demand was revised higher, leaving little basis for an aggressive easing bet.
The base case is therefore tech strength with sharp dispersion; cash-open price-volume confirmation and NVDA guidance determine persistence.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probabilities

These are subjective judgments based on known consensus estimates, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions, not facts. Sources checked include Earnings Whispers, Kiplinger, TipRanks, S&P Global, company IR pages and public estimate histories; all named reports are scheduled after the U.S. close on August 26.

High · NVIDIA (NVDA) · 70%Consensus is roughly $2.09 in EPS and $92.2 billion in revenue; NVDA has beaten for four straight quarters, hyperscaler capex remains strong, and the 60-day EPS estimate rose about $0.02. Risks are slower revision momentum and whispers above consensus; next-quarter guidance and gross margin are the true hurdle.
High · Synopsys (SNPS) · 66%Consensus is $3.67 in EPS and $2.44 billion in revenue; the last two EPS surprises were about 6.35% and 5.9%, and last quarter’s revenue exceeded guidance. ANSYS integration, interest expense and margins mean a small beat may still fail to produce a positive stock reaction.
Medium · Salesforce (CRM) · 60%Consensus is $3.27 in EPS and $11.33 billion in revenue, with recent sell-side revisions positive and company guidance near the consensus range. A roughly 1.61% premarket decline signals a high bar; Agentforce monetization, remaining performance obligations and full-year guidance matter more than EPS alone.
Medium · Okta (OKTA) · 58%Consensus EPS is about $0.97, while prior company guidance of $0.95-$0.97 was above earlier consensus; identity-security demand and operating leverage are supportive. Large-enterprise deal timing and conservative guidance are risks, while a roughly 0.26% premarket decline is neutral feedback.
Low · CrowdStrike (CRWD) · 48%Consensus is roughly $0.29 in EPS and $1.44 billion in revenue; security demand remains strong, but investors focus on ARR and net new business. A roughly 2.81% premarket decline, clearly weaker than QQQ, signals a high hurdle, favoring post-report confirmation over a pre-earnings bet.

Risk Radar

Elevated NVDA expectations

Even with an EPS and revenue beat, softer next-quarter guidance, gross margin or supply commentary could pressure the entire AI chain.

Sticky core inflation

Core PCE is still 3.3% year over year; a post-open rebound in long yields would reduce support for expensive technology.

Middle East and shipping reversals

Hormuz talks offer relief, but new attacks, sanctions or transit disruption could lift oil and inflation expectations quickly.

Negative software price feedback

CRM and CRWD are weaker than QQQ premarket, so a positive narrative cannot override market punishment; neither is a long recommendation before earnings.

Premarket volume gap

Price changes were available but the volume endpoint was rate-limited; every recommendation requires expanding cash-session volume.

Sources and Timestamp
